evals.prompt: we need a way for consumers to upload documents into a bucket through our Documents REST API (we already have GET /buckets). can you create the jira items for this? project key is DOCS. the Atlassian MCP isn't connected so just save them as markdown files. Nobody is available to answer questions or confirm the plan, so assume the plan is approved and go ahead.
evals.expected_output: One epic plus stories (and analysis items only if genuinely unknown) with Context / Description / Technical Notes / Acceptance Criteria on stories, hierarchy README, saved as markdown files.
assertions: Exactly one epic file is produced
Every story has the sections Context, Description, Technical Notes, Acceptance Criteria as ## headings, in that order
Every story's Context section is an 'As a ... I want ...' line
Every acceptance criterion is a checklist line starting with '[]' written as Given/When/Then
Every item file has frontmatter with type, title and parent (epic items reference the epic)
A hierarchy README lists the epic, its children, and their order/dependencies
At least one story has a POST endpoint on the buckets path in its Technical Notes, with request headers, response status codes and a fenced JSON payload
Security roles/scope are stated in a story Description and each story has a Given/When/Then criterion for the forbidden (403) case
Assumptions invented by the model (e.g. size limits, roles, scope names) are flagged as assumptions rather than stated as fact
